title: Introduce presubmit plugin and dependency-audit orchestrator
author: Priya Kapoor
description:
Motivation: Reduce presubmit latency and improve dependency hygiene by introducing a lightweight presubmit plugin that runs a fast dependency-audit pass and orchestrates staged lint/test lanes. This PR introduces an orchestrator service and a GitHub Actions plugin wrapper that performs targeted checks based on changed paths, runs a fast dependency snapshot + vulnerability audit, and fences slow checks into staged lanes.

Summary of changes: - new presubmit plugin (go) that inspects changed files and emits a compact manifest for the runner - dependency-audit harness that generates a lockfile snapshot and runs safety checks against a curated advisory feed - action composite wrapper and action.yml to wire the plugin into existing workflows - small upgrades to makefile and ci tooling to expose path-matching predicates - migration of the monolithic lint job into three staged lanes (fast, medium, slow) with a coordinator step - integration tests for the plugin and sample workflow templates under .github/quickpaths

Checklist: - [x] implement plugin core and CLI - [x] composite Action wrapper + action.yml - [x] unit tests for path-matching and audit logic - [x] integration workflows in repo: ci/integ-presubmit.yml - [x] docs: docs/ci/presubmit-plugin.md - [x] staged rollout via feature flag

Rollout plan: Feature-flag off by default. Deploy plugin as a Docker image in CI registry, update a small set of repos (redwood, redwood-sdk-python) to opt-in to staged lanes, monitor premerge latency and false-positive rates for 2 weeks, then enable org-wide. A rollback plan exists by removing action reference or flipping feature flag.

Notes: This PR intentionally keeps the slow checks separate to preserve fast feedback for most changes. The dependency-audit uses a permissive advisory threshold to avoid noisy flakes; the evaluator will tighten after initial telemetry.

release_notes:
- Add presubmit plugin to perform targeted path-aware presubmit checks and dependency audit
- Introduce staged presubmit lanes (fast/medium/slow) to reduce premerge latency
- Provide action wrapper and templates for gradual rollout
- Integration tests and docs included
notes: This PR is part of a larger ENG-3421 initiative to improve premerge feedback. Observability hooks (premerge latency and audit false-positive counters) were added to the plugin and will be consumed by Redwood Console.
